message.content:
Based on the **All Courses** section design, here is the extreme pixel-perfect analysis:

## 1. Section Background & Layout
- **Background Color**: `#F8F9FE` (Very light periwinkle/lavender tint, not pure white)
- **Section Padding**: `80px` top / `80px` bottom (desktop), `48px` mobile
- **Container Max-width**: `1280px` centered with `24px` horizontal padding

## 2. Header Architecture
- **Badge**: 
  - Text: "🔥 EXPLORE & LEARN" (emoji + uppercase)
  - Background: `#EDE9FE` (light purple)
  - Text Color: `#6D28D9` (violet-700)
  - Font: `12px` / `600` weight
  - Padding: `6px 16px`
  - Border Radius: `20px` (pill shape)
  
- **Main Heading**:
  - Text: "All Courses"
  - Font Size: `48px` (desktop) / `36px` (mobile)
  - Weight: `800` (extra bold)
  - Color: `#1E1B4B` (indigo-950, near black-purple)
  - Margin Top: `20px`
  
- **Subtitle**:
  - Text: "Discover our comprehensive collection of courses designed to help you master new skills and advance your career."
  - Font Size: `18px`
  - Color: `#64748B` (slate-500)
  - Line Height: `1.6`
  - Max Width: `650px`, centered
  - Margin Top: `16px`

- **Underline Accent**: 
  - Width: `60px`
  - Height: `4px`
  - Color: `#4F46E5` (indigo-600)
  - Border Radius: `2px`
  - Position: Centered below subtitle, margin-top `24px`

## 3. Stats Bar (White Container)
- **Background**: `#FFFFFF`
- **Border Radius**: `16px`
- **Padding**: `24px 32px`
- **Shadow**: `0 4px 20px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.08)` (subtle indigo tint)
- **Layout**: 4-column grid, space-between
- **Items**: Icon (40x40 circle bg) + Number (bold 24px) + Label (14px slate-600)

## 4. Filter Bar
- **Active Tab ("All Courses")**: 
  - Bg: `#4F46E5` (indigo-600)
  - Text: White
  - Radius: `10px`
  - Padding: `10px 20px`
  
- **Inactive Tabs**: 
  - Bg: Transparent/White
  - Text: `#475569` (slate-600)
  - Border: `1px solid #E2E8F0`
  - Radius: `10px`
  - Hover: Light gray bg

- **Search Input**: 
  - Width: `280px`
  - Placeholder: "Search courses..."
  - Icon: Search (left, slate-400)
  - Border: `1px solid #E2E8F0`
  - Radius: `10px`
  - Padding: `12px 16px 12px 44px`

## 5. Card Grid System
- **Columns**: 4 (desktop) → 2 (tablet) → 1 (mobile)
- **Gap**: `24px` (all axes)

## 6. Individual Card Design (Pixel Perfect)

### Container
- **Background**: `#FFFFFF`
- **Border Radius**: `16px`
- **Shadow**: 
  - Default: `0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
  - Hover: `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.15)` + translateY(-4px)
- **Overflow**: Hidden
- **Border**: None (shadow only)
- **Bottom Border Accent**: `3px solid` (color varies by card theme: purple/green/blue/orange)

### Image Section
- **Height**: `200px` (fixed aspect ratio ~16:9)
- **Object Fit**: Cover
- **Position**: Relative
- **Overlay Gradient**: Linear gradient from transparent to `rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` at bottom for text readability

### Image Badges (Top Left)
- **Position**: Absolute, `top: 12px`, `left: 12px`
- **Padding**: `6px 12px`
- **Font Size**: `11px`
- **Weight**: `700`
- **Text Transform**: Uppercase
- **Letter Spacing**: `0.5px`
- **Border Radius**: `6px`
- **Variants**:
  - "BEST SELLER": Bg `#F97316` (orange-500), Text White
  - "TRENDING": Bg `#10B981` (emerald-500), Text White

### Duration Badge (Bottom Right of Image)
- **Position**: Absolute, `bottom: 12px`, `right: 12px`
- **Background**: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)` (semi-transparent black)
- **Color**: White
- **Padding**: `4px 10px`
- **Border Radius**: `6px`
- **Font Size**: `12px`
- **Font Weight**: `600`

### Bookmark Icon (Top Right)
- **Position**: Absolute, `top: 12px`, `right: 12px`
- **Size**: `32px` container
- **Background**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)` (backdrop blur optional)
- **Border Radius**: `8px`
- **Icon**: Outline bookmark (slate-600), hover fills/solid

### Category Icon Overlay (Bottom Left on Image)
- **Position**: Absolute, `bottom: -20px` (overlaps content area), `left: 16px`
- **Size**: `48px x 48px`
- **Background**: `#FFFFFF`
- **Border Radius**: `12px`
- **Shadow**: `0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`
- **Icon**: 
  - Code icon (`</>`) for dev - Purple tint
  - Brain icon for AI - Green tint
  - Phone icon for mobile - Blue tint
  - Megaphone for marketing - Orange tint
- **Z-index**: 10 (above image, below content padding)

## 7. Content Area (Below Image)
- **Padding**: `28px 20px 24px 20px` (extra top padding to clear the overlapping icon)

### Rating Row
- **Layout**: Flex, space-between, items center
- **Left Side**: Star icon (`#FBBF24` amber-400) + Rating number (`4.9`) + Review count in parentheses (`(1.2K)`)
  - Rating Font: `14px`, `700`, `#1E293B` (slate-800)
  - Count Font: `13px`, `500`, `#64748B`
- **Right Side**: Price
  - Font Size: `20px`
  - Weight: `800`
  - Color: `#4F46E5` (indigo-600)
  - Symbol: `₹` (Rupee)

### Title
- **Font Size**: `18px`
- **Weight**: `700`
- **Color**: `#0F172A` (slate-900)
- **Line Height**: `1.3`
- **Margin Top**: `12px`
- **Max Lines**: 2 (with ellipsis overflow)
- **Font Family**: Inter/SF Pro (system sans-serif)

### Description
- **Font Size**: `14px`
- **Line Height**: `1.6`
- **Color**: `#64748B` (slate-500)
- **Margin Top**: `8px`
- **Max Lines**: 2

### Tags Container
- **Display**: Flex, flex-wrap, gap `8px`
- **Margin Top**: `16px`
- **Tag Style**:
  - Background: Varies by category:
    - Dev: `#EEF2FF` (indigo-50)
    - AI: `#ECFDF5` (emerald-50)
    - Mobile: `#EFF6FF` (blue-50)
    - Marketing: `#FFF7ED` (orange-50)
  - Text Color: Matches category primary color (indigo-600/emerald-600/blue-600/orange-600)
  - Font Size: `12px`
  - Weight: `600`
  - Padding: `4px 10px`
  - Border Radius: `6px`
  - Border: None (solid bg)

## 8. Enroll Button
- **Width**: 100% (full width of card content area minus padding)
- **Height**: `44px`
- **Background**: `#FFFFFF` (transparent/white)
- **Border**: 
  - Width: `1.5px`
  - Color: Matches card accent (indigo-500/emerald-500/blue-500/orange-500)
  - Style: Solid
- **Border Radius**: `10px`
- **Text**: "Enroll Now"
- **Font Size**: `14px`
- **Font Weight**: `600`
- **Color**: Matches border color (indigo-600 etc.)
- **Icon**: Chevron right (`>`) at end, `14px`
- **Hover Effect**: 
  - Background: Matching color at 5% opacity (e.g., `rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.05)`)
  - Slight translate X or shadow increase
- **Margin Top**: `20px`
- **Transition**: All `0.2s ease`

## 9. Special Offer Banner (Below Grid)
- **Background**: `#FFFFFF`
- **Border Radius**: `12px`
- **Padding**: `20px 24px`
- **Border**: `1px solid #E2E8F0`
- **Layout**: Flex, space-between, align-center
- **Left**: Gift icon (purple bg `#EDE9FE`, rounded-lg) + "Special Offer!" (bold, slate-900) + Subtitle text (slate-500)
- **Right**: CTA Button "View Offers" (bg `#4F46E5`, text white, radius `8px`, padding `10px 20px`)
- **Margin Top**: `40px`

## 10. Special Effects & Details
- **Card Bottom Border**: Each card has a `3px` colored bottom border matching its category theme (creates visual cohesion with tags/button)
- **Image Hover**: Slight scale `1.02` with transition `0.3s ease`
- **Bookmark Interaction**: Click toggles fill color to indigo-600
- **Responsive Breakpoints**:
  - `< 1024px`: 2 columns
  - `< 640px`: 1 column, reduced padding
- **Typography**: System font stack preferring `Inter`, `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`
- **Accessibility**: All interactive elements have `min-height: 44px` touch targets

This design uses a **cohesive color-coding system** where each course category (Development/AI/Mobile/Marketing) carries its accent color through the badge, icon tint, tag backgrounds, button borders, and bottom card border.
